issues.title: LAUNCH-01 | Joint inquiry activation gates — ASSEMBL LAB + WOOD U LIKE
issues.body:
# LAUNCH-01 — הפעלת פניות לשני האתרים (LEAN TASK PLANNING v1.1)

**Priority:** P0  
**Lead:** ChatGPT (מומלץ); Codex רק לשינויי קוד/בדיקות שלא ניתן לבצע ישירות ובאמינות  
**Status:** BLOCKED ON OWNER APPROVALS / NO LIVE ACTIVATION

## Verified baseline (29 October 2026)
- ASSEMBL LAB `inquiry/contact-config.js`: endpoint Formspree configured; email fallback configured; no explicit privacy/form-approval flags. `inquiry/inquiry.js` offers a real POST path when endpoint is present; this is **not** evidence of successful delivery.
- WOOD U LIKE `inquiry/contact-config.js`: same endpoint; `formDestinationApproved=false`, `privacyApproved=false`, `contactDetailsApproved=false`; all must remain unchanged until authorized. Its documented activation sequence is `inquiry/ACTIVATION_HE.md` and WUL-006 #9.
- No owner-account access or verified real end-to-end delivery. No real POST sent.

## G0 — approvals/identity (P0, owner with ChatGPT preparation)
1. Confirm shared Formspree destination/authorized account and which staff can access submissions.
2. Review and approve Hebrew/English privacy notices, retention/deletion/access and marketing practices for **each** brand, including appropriate legally required business identification; do not silently remove legally required disclosure. Prefer public brand in marketing copy; separate mandatory legal identity and display name.
3. Approve privacy contact and public fallback channels; do not publish new personal contact information unapproved.
4. Verify data collection and notification behavior including domain restriction, spam, workflows and quotas.
**Acceptance:** owner approval recorded for exact copy/settings; no PII or credentials in GitHub.

## G1 — implementation/readiness (P0, ChatGPT first)
1. Preserve WUL fail-closed behavior and existing WUL-006 controls.
2. Audit ASSEMBL LAB real-POST behavior and establish privacy-compliant controls and a safe activation procedure without unnecessary regression. Any required code change via dedicated branch, PR, QA; do not interrupt the public site without explicit decision.
3. Validate branding, source attribution, product IDs, error handling, HE/EN and mobile under mocked network.
**Acceptance:** reproducible passing mocked QA, no actual POST.

## G2 — authorized controlled live tests (owner authorization separately)
- One scoped test per brand only after G0/G1 and separate explicit approval, using synthetic non-identifying data, without automatic retries.
- Check each message in shared Formspree inbox outside spam, verify notification routing and brand/subject/product.
**Acceptance:** evidence of actual inbox receipt and notification, not merely browser success.

## G3 — public activation (requires separate explicit owner authorization)
- Enable WOOD U LIKE only via reviewed PR after G2: approved `formDestinationApproved` and `privacyApproved`; `contactDetailsApproved` stays false unless separately authorized.
- Confirm ASSEMBL LAB launch state/necessary privacy notices. Do not assume existing endpoint equals verified production readiness.
- Independent QA >=90/100, no blockers, production smoke, owner GO decision, fallback and rollback tested.
**Acceptance:** owner-approved active reception confirmed for both brands.

## Gate status
- G0 PENDING owner decisions
- G1 PARTIAL code audit, full QA not executed
- G2 NOT AUTHORIZED / NOT EXECUTED
- G3 NOT AUTHORIZED / NOT EXECUTED

Related: [WUL-006](https://github.com/mataniar0/wood-u-like-site/issues/9), [ASSEMBL LEADS-AS-04](https://github.com/mataniar0/assembl-lab-site/issues/15). No merge, deploy, configuration mutation or live submissions are authorized by this coordination issue.

issues.title: LAUNCH-01 G1 | Safe privacy notices and form readiness in both brands
issues.body: P0. Implement and review bilingual form privacy disclosure and safe mock QA, without activating real submissions. ASSEMBL LAB requires a visible Section 11 collection notice and full policy link, subject to final legal approval. WOOD U LIKE must retain its three false approval flags and synchronize only after approved legal text. No live POST, no Merge or Deploy before privacy/controller identification and independent QA >=90. Per LEAN TASK PLANNING v1.1: ChatGPT primary, Codex only for proof/automation tasks not feasible directly. Acceptance: source-level tests, accessibility, no sensitive data in GitHub, clear pending legal placeholders excluded from public deployment. Related #18 and WUL-006 #9.

issues.title: LAUNCH-01 G0 | Read-only live browser privacy/network audit for both brands
issues.body: P0 / LAUNCH-01. Live GitHub Pages host cannot be reached from assistant web/container environments, so an actual browser-based privacy/network audit remains UNVERIFIED (not a site failure). Need execute read-only browser probe against both public sites (root, inquiry, sample product/collection) and both he/en. Capture origins of outbound GET resources; request hostnames/methods; cookies set/read, localStorage/sessionStorage keys; service workers; form POST attempts blocked by interception; iframe/analytics/tracker hits; 320 and 390px display; response status and console errors. Do not send a real customer inquiry or persist any PII. Compare results to source-audit expectations: first-party language localStorage, WUL campaign sessionStorage, shared Formspree only on actual deliberate submit. Include report JSON with redacted URL queries and screenshots with no identifying information. Gate final privacy text on verified facts; maintain WUL false activation flags and leave ASSEMBL LAB unchanged. ChatGPT lead; Codex/CI browser runner recommended because external host access is restricted. QA >=90/100 and zero blockers before merge. Related #18 and #20.

planning: LEAN TASK PLANNING v1.1 referenced by issue #18; no standalone versioned specification present in either checkout. Bounded plan: inspect, guarded browser audit, mocks, evidence validation, reports-only draft PR; no activation.
